sources.validityDomain: Thermodynamic energetics of specified microbial redox and related reactions under stated temperatures/compositions; Wave IV uses this only to justify source-bound reaction free-energy state, not occurrence.
assumptions: Reaction identity and thermodynamic state are externally supplied
sources.uncertainty: Reaction energetics can vary strongly with temperature and composition; no universal reaction inventory or flux is implied.

sources.validityDomain: Energy availability and maintenance constraints for known subsurface life; used to preserve separation between environmental free-energy supply and biologically usable/maintenance-sufficient energy.
assumptions: Biological energetic thresholds are environment and organism dependent
sources.uncertainty: Does not establish universal extraterrestrial biological capture efficiency or maintenance threshold.
